limits: 8-byte base instructions; LDDW consumes two slots and is excluded from this short candidate.
EXIT is exactly 9500000000000000; b7 is MOV, not EXIT. CALL src=1 is code-relative pseudo-call; src=0 helper uses syscall space and is not an owned callee edge.
This is static SDK pcode, not kernel verifier or BPF runtime validity.
cpu_boundary: SDK selection only, no CPU execution
function_truth_origin: manual hand-owned source extent frozen before ProgramDB creation
function_bound_policy: Half-open byte ranges; SuperH includes intrinsic return/call delay slots; Hexagon consists only of complete one-word packets.
